basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a software developer based in Toronto, Canada. I have a passion for learning new programming languages and exploring the latest tech trends. In my free time, I love working on DIY projects and trading cryptocurrencies. I'm currently working as a full-stack developer at a mid-sized tech company. I'm in a committed relationship and usually online in the evenings and weekends when I'm not busy coding or researching. I enjoy a good challenge and frequently participate in coding competitions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over five years. My expertise lies in web development, particularly using React, PHP, and Node.js. I am largely self-taught when it comes to blockchain and cryptocurrency, which I explore as a hobby.
